description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeCsvImportController class within the OrangeHRM application. The class manages the CSV import interface for employee data, utilizing Vue components and traits for configuration. It mainly sets up a Vue component with properties indicating allowed file types and maximum file size in its preRender method.

classes.name: EmployeeCsvImportController
classes.description: Controller class handling the CSV import view for employee data, extending an abstract Vue controller and setting up necessary Vue components.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets a Vue component ('employee-data-import') with properties for allowed file types and maximum file size for the CSV import interface.
